Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِيْ لَاأَرْجُوْ إِلَّا فَضْلَهُ
Translation: In the name of Allah, from whom I hope for nothing but His grace
And fear nothing but His justice
And rely on nothing but His word
And hold fast to nothing but His rope

Arabic text: بِكَ أَسْتَجِيرُ يَا ذَا الْعَفْوِ وَالرِّضْوَانِ
Translation: I seek Your protection, O Lord of forgiveness and pleasure
From oppression and transgression
And from the changes of time
And the succession of sorrows
And the calamities of events

Arabic text: وَمِنِ انْقِضَاءِ الْمُدَّةِ قَبْلَ التَّأَهُّبِ وَالْعُدَّةِ
Translation: And from the end of my life's term before preparation and readiness

Arabic text: وَ إِيَّاكَ أَسْتَرْشِدُ لِمَا فِيهِ الصَّلَاحُ وَالْإِصْلاَحُ
Translation: I seek Your guidance for what is righteous and beneficial

Arabic text: وَبِكَ أَسْتَعِينُ فِيْمَا يَقْتَرِنُ بِهِ النَّجَاحُ وَ الْإِنْجَاحُ
Translation: And I seek Your help in what leads to success and accomplishment

Arabic text: وَ إِيَّاكَ أَرْغَبُ فِيْ لِبَاسِ الْعَافِيَةِ وَتَمَامِهَا
Translation: And I desire from You the garment of well-being and its completion
And the inclusiveness of safety and its permanence

Arabic text: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ يَا رَبِّ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ
Translation: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, from the temptations of the devils

Arabic text: وَ أَحْتَرِزُ بِسُلْطَانِكَ مِنْ جَوْرِ السَّلَاطِينِ
Translation: And I seek protection through Your authority from the oppression of rulers

Arabic text: فَتَقَبَّلْ مَا كَانَ مِنْ صَلَاتِيْ وَصَوْمِيْ
Translation: So accept what was from my prayers and fasting

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْ غَدِيْ وَمَا بَعْدَهُ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ سَاعَتِيْ وَيَوْمِيْ
Translation: And make my tomorrow and what follows better than my hour and day
And honor me among my clan and people
And protect me in my wakefulness and sleep
For You are Allah, the Best Guardian
And You are the Most Merciful of those who show mercy

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَبْرَأُ إِلَيْكَ فِيْ يَوْمِيْ هٰذَا
Translation: O Allah, I disassociate myself before You in this day of mine
And in all Sundays to come
From polytheism and atheism
And I dedicate my supplication purely to You
Seeking an answer
And I remain steadfast in Your obedience
Hoping for reward
So send blessings upon Muhammad, the best of Your creation
The one who calls to Your truth
And honor me with Your honor that is never humiliated
And protect me with Your eye that never sleeps
And seal my affairs with devotion to You alone
And my life with forgiveness
Indeed, You are the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful
